newsitem.title: GERMANY: SGL Carbon unit takes over RK Carbon in UK.
newsitem.headline: SGL Carbon unit takes over RK Carbon in UK.

text.p: German carbon and graphite producer SGL Carbon AG AG said on Monday its SGL Technik GmbH unit has taken over British carbon fibre producer RK Carbon. The purchase price was not disclosed.

RK Carbon is one of the world market leaders in the production of fibres used in aeroplane brakes and carbonised fibres, SGL said in a statement. SGL Technik has until now been limited to industrial applications in this field.

The British company is based in Inverness, Scotland, with revenue equivalent to about 30 million marks, SGL Carbon said. The acquisition should lead to considerable synergy benefits, particularly in the important U.S. market, it added.

The German group is the world's largest producer of graphite. In November it said pretax profit for the first nine months of 1996 rose 35 percent to 223 million marks, as sales climbed 10 percent to 1.29 billion marks.
